notes: Key ask: shipping a low-latency conversational assistant inside their SaaS cockpit. Primary workload: streaming chat with tool calls to search + CRM + internal DB. Quote from CTO: "Tooling calls must not add >50ms to perceived token stream". Customer is piloting Hosted API to validate latency SLOs and rollout strategy; if SLOs and costs align they will move to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput. Wants an eval harness: per-prompt regression gating, thresholded pass rates, and automated canary/A-B rollouts with rollback triggers. Cost sensitivity: mid-market buyer, wants ARR analysis vs hosted token pricing — CFO expects clear break-even within 6–9 months before committing to Dedicated. Security needs: SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, EU residency option for a subset of traffic. POC success criteria: p95 streaming token-to-token latency <=300ms for 95% of sessions, tool-call success rate >99%, and no regression in top-10 prompt evals compared to baseline. Notes are fragmentary — follow-up required on quantization recommendations and autoscaling policy for Dedicated.
poc_summary: POC scope: 2-week burst of production-like traffic (3k sessions/day) against Hosted API streaming endpoint with tool-calling. Metrics collected: per-token latency (p50,p90,p95), end-to-end turn latency with tool call, token cost, quality eval on 1200 prompt set. Acceptance: p95 <=300ms, tool-call latency median <120ms, eval pass rate delta <=1% vs baseline. Plan: iterate batching, KV cache, and model variant (8-bit quantized) to hit latency; if stable, price Dedicated proposal and run 2-week Dedicated pilot with same traffic for final decision.
pricing_discussions: Customer running rough TCO model: hosted run estimate $12k/month at current volume; Dedicated commit would be ~$6k/month fixed plus incremental ops — CFO wants a 6-month ROI case. Asked for proposal with 3 commitment tiers and burst policies. Requested explicit per-token vs committed throughput mapping and fallback cost for overflow.
